Latin word

mīlitia

mīlitia, mīlitiae f.

noun, first declension

military service

In this lexicon

  • military

    also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 5.55: domī mīlitiaeque (Lewis & Short); Traupman 187: in peace and in war, on the home front and the front line, domī et mīlitiae

  • military service

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 3.97: mīlitiam subterfugere (Lewis & Short); Traupman 187, 188, 396, 404
